source.title: Larne Times, 19 May 1949, p. 5 ("No interest shown: Larne R.D.C. elections")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Larne rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests: only five divisions returned nomination papers, and the retiring members in the others were deemed re-elected. W. J. Hawkins was the only new member, for Islandmagee South. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Larne Times, 19 May 1949, p. 5 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the round note now gives the new Islandmagee South member's printed initials, W. J. Hawkins.
